enchantments.tooltip: Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Dexterity +14: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Reflex Save +12: This item gives a +12 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
